parameters.name: executeEndTime
parameters.description: Last execution end time of the pipeline

parameters.name: executeStartTime
parameters.description: Last execution start time of the pipeline

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Maximum supported value is 50.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: resultStatusList
parameters.description: Last run status of the pipeline. Multiple values separated by commas. Valid values: SUCCESS (Succeeded), RUNNING (running), FAIL (failed), CANCELED (canceled), WAITING (waiting)
